description: Section 9.5 step 9 applies Section 7.2's money encoding to agreed_terms: its currency must be one the implementation can state minor amounts in, and every line item states its money as integer minor units under the pinned keys. Each case is transaction-record-basis.json's bound record with agreed_terms.line_items set as the case says (and, where a case names one, the record and its terms in another currency) and both acts re-signed with that vector's test-only keys, so the record hash, act hash, offer chain and both signatures are genuine: a producer signed these terms itself. Verify each record with did_documents and the case's offer_hashes; both implementations must reach the stated verdict and expected_reason (null when the record verifies) for the same bytes. The control cases pin that the line item stays open to deal-type extension fields and that an integral amount spelled as a whole-number float is an integer.

cases.name: pinned_minor_keys
cases.description: Pinned unit_price_minor and total_minor, integer minor units.

cases.name: pinned_with_deal_type_extension_fields
cases.description: Pinned keys beside the goods_procurement extension fields (Section 18): the line item stays open.

cases.name: whole_number_float_minor
cases.description: 36000.0 and 36000 are one JSON number (RFC 8785): an integral value however it is spelled.

cases.name: empty_line_items
cases.description: An empty array states no line and breaks no rule.

cases.name: bare_major_units
cases.description: The gap: bare unit_price and total in major units, signed directly by the producer.

cases.name: bare_beside_pinned
cases.description: A bare key beside the pinned ones is still refused by name.

cases.name: fractional_minor
cases.description: A fractional amount is not an integer number of minor units.

cases.name: string_minor
cases.description: An amount is a JSON number, not text.

cases.name: beyond_safe_integer
cases.description: Beyond 2^53 - 1 the two languages cannot hold the amount exactly.

cases.name: negative_quantity
cases.description: A refund is a negative price, not a negative count.

cases.name: second_line_bare
cases.description: Every line is checked, not only the first.

cases.name: line_item_not_object
cases.description: A line item is an object.

cases.name: line_items_not_array
cases.description: line_items, where present, is an array.

cases.name: line_items_null
cases.description: A null line_items is present, and is not an array.

cases.name: supported_currency_eur
cases.description: Pinned line items in EUR, a currency this build carries minor amounts in.

cases.name: unsupported_currency_with_line_items
cases.description: Minor units mean nothing until the currency's exponent is known to be 2: JPY is not one this build can establish.

cases.name: unsupported_currency_without_line_items
cases.description: The currency condition holds whether or not the terms carry line items, as on the offer path.
